title: Sunny Fruits for Kids! Pineapple, Mango and More with Pip
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're meeting five sunny fruits, bright and sweet and a little bit sour.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Yummy food and healthy habits help us grow, play and learn every day.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen and find out!

lines: Here's a clue: it's spiky on top, bumpy outside, and sweet and yellow inside! Can you guess?
This is Pineapple! Can you say pineapple?
Pineapples do not grow on trees! They grow on a spiky plant, close to the ground.
Each pineapple grows for a long, long time. More than a whole year!
Can you make spiky leaves on your head? Hands up, fingers out, like a pineapple crown!
What are the spiky leaves on top called?
The crown! Like a king or queen of fruits.
One more time, nice and loud: PINEAPPLE!
Pineapple is sweet and tangy, and so sunny yellow inside.
Here's a clue: it's shaped like a big bean, and it can be green, yellow, orange and red! Can you guess?
This is Mango! Can you say mango?
Mangoes grow on big, tall trees where the weather is warm.
Inside, a mango is soft, orange and very sweet.
Can you pretend to pick a mango from a tall tree? Reach up, up, up!
What's hiding in the middle of a mango?
One big, flat seed! It's almost as big as your hand.
One more time, nice and loud: MANGO!
Mangoes are sweet and soft, and they smell like sunshine.
Here's a clue: it's bright yellow, it grows on a tree, and it tastes very sour! Can you guess?
This is Lemon! Can you say lemon?
Lemons grow on trees, and they are full of juice.
Lemon juice is sour! It can make your face go squish, like this.
Can you make a silly sour face? Squeeze your eyes and pucker up!
How can we use a lemon?
Squeeze a little juice into water, or on fish, or into a yummy sauce!
One more time, nice and loud: LEMON!
Lemons are sour all by themselves, but a little squeeze adds a bright, fresh taste.
Here's a clue: it's bumpy and dark green outside, and soft and creamy inside! Can you guess?
This is Avocado! Can you say avocado?
An avocado grows on a tree. And guess what? It's a fruit!
Inside, it's soft, creamy and light green, so you can mash it with a fork.
Can you pretend to mash an avocado? Squish, squish, squish!
What's the big round ball in the middle?
The seed! It's called a pit, and it's very big.
One more time, nice and loud: AVOCADO!
You can spread mashed avocado on toast, or dip veggies in it.
Here's a clue: it's round and juicy, and it has the same name as its color! Can you guess?
This is Orange! Can you say orange?
Oranges grow on trees, where the weather is warm and sunny.
Peel off the skin, and inside are juicy pieces called segments.
Can you pretend to peel an orange? Round and round and round!
How many pieces are inside an orange?
Often about ten! Let's count them next time.
One more time, nice and loud: ORANGE!
Oranges are sweet and juicy, and they smell so fresh.

recap: Yummy! Let's remember what we learned.
And orange, full of juicy pieces!
outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
